title: Spoiler Free thoughts on the absolutely perfect Wicked #wickedmovie
transcript: I just got home from seeing the wicked movie, and I can't. I still. I still can't believe it happened. It's real. I saw it with my own eyes. It was perfect. It was absolutely perfect. It did feel a little long, and I feel like that's because I'm so used to it going so fast. I mean, that's like, what, an hour and some change of the stage show that is now a two hour, 40 minute movie. But I wouldn't. I wouldn't change any of it. I think all the new stuff that we got was. Was great. Um, it just felt like sometimes the pacing was a little slower than I'm used to. But the visuals, stunning. The new choreography, great. Every single cast member is just so perfectly cast. And the new orchestrations, oh my gosh, they are so good. Like, thank goodness the soundtrack dropped literally 20 minutes before I got out of the movie, so I can now listen to it. But it was just so good. There are definitely spoilers on the soundtrack, so just if you want to go in blind, uh, do not listen to the soundtrack beforehand. I love how many new choices these singers made in some of the songs. Just really, really, really great. I also went with my family, who have never seen the stage show, and they also really loved it. Except for my brother in law, who just doesn't like musicals, which, you know, Fair. But to quote my dad, he said, uh, I'm really excited for the next part because everything he knew about wicked was in the first movie, so they have no idea what happens in part two, which I'm, I'm really excited to see it next year. I just, uh, John and Chu really knocked it out of the park. Uh, every, everybody involved did, but just. It was so good. It was so good. And I cannot wait for part 2 next year because I truly, after seeing this movie tonight, I truly think that they're gonna fix some of the major issues in part 2. I, I cannot wait to see how they fix it, because the songs have always been good, but it always has felt so rushed. And now that we have this movie that is able to take its time and breathe, it's solving a lot of those issues. So I just. I can't wait. I can't wait. And if you've seen the wicked movie, let me know. Let me know what you thought.
